entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, cat. XXIII, n° 3 to 5 
The reduced rate only applies to:
- walking frames: 8716 8000
- apparatus to be worn on the person and allowing continuous or intermittent injection of medicaments by means of a hypodermic needle supplied by an electronically controlled pump: 9018 3110
- outpatient rehabilitators:  9019 1090
- aerosol devices and their accessories: 9019 2000  
- anti-decubitus material: 9404 90 90

entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment:
Tabel I prov. a.34 and b.1: carriages and crutches for the disabled; stand-up chairs; high-low beds. A vehicle for the disabled is defined as a means of transport that is designed to be used by a disabled person. The term can also include motor vehicles which are equipped for use by a disabled person. 

Only carriages that within social standards are regarded as a vehicle for the invalid on the basis of its destination and presentation are included.

When those goods are imported from a third territory or a third country, the reduced VAT rate is conditioned by submission of the Customs Notice for medical devices or the Declaration of conformity of the medical device manufacturer according to art.12 of the Order no.1009/2016. Art.294 para.(5) letters c), d) of the Fiscal Code.
